_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits on the Complacency ceiling with offsetting downside cluster and liquidity support; no rung-breaker has fired, so skilled HOLD inside the coil is the base-rate call.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative outflow + bottom analog imply constructive bias without a matching forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 47-54 and 30d momentum stays low-40s with no range break or funding flip
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks under 46 with ETF flows near 0 and CVD sub-30, or flows rebound and F&G pushes through 55
